why_this_exists: Admitting grok-cli / grok-4.7 mutates a CI-enforced proof contract. Per the precedent packets (TP-DMX-EMBEDDED-AUDIT-GROK-ROUTE-001, TP-DMX-EMBEDDED-AUDIT-OPENCODE-KIMI-001), scope is set by a deterministic consumer inventory so that every change and every non-change has recorded evidence.

method.search: git grep -n -I -E 'grok-4\.5|grok-cli|auditor_model|auditor_tool' over the whole tracked tree excluding only proof/, docker/ and lockfiles, followed by a second git grep for the other admitted pair members (gemini-3.1-pro-high, kimi-k3, opencode-cli) to find enumerations of the embedded-audit vocabulary that do not mention grok at all.
method.then: Every hit outside tests/, task-packets/, claudedocs/ and audit_inputs/ (historical records and archived evidence, not consumers) was read in source rather than classified from the grep line.
method.cross_check: tests/audit, tests/unit/governed_execution/audit_identity, tests/governance, tests/auditor_router, tests/pr_steward, tests/pr_merge_specialist and tests/unit/governed_execution were executed against the modified schema; scripts/audit/validate_audit_proof.py --all proof/ was run before and after the schema edit with byte-identical output (163/163 PASS).

changed.change: Added grok-4.7 to the auditor_model enum; changed the existing 'auditor_tool == grok-cli' conditional's then from const grok-4.5 to enum [grok-4.5, grok-4.7] (then.required kept); added one new conditional 'auditor_model == grok-4.7 => auditor_tool == grok-cli' with then.required. auditor_tool enum is unchanged.

Valid for every non-SKIPPED status; grok-4.7 with any other tool invalid; grok-cli with any other model invalid (including unknown, grok-4.6, build labels); both conditionals proven independent of the enums; 4.5 pair unchanged; SKIPPED unchanged; exact-surface and exact-delta guards against the pre-change schema; hermetic hash-pinned differential over all pre-change tool/model pairs and all five statuses.

changed.change: test_pre_change_enum_members_still_accepted filtered jsonschema errors on validator == 'enum' at instance path /auditor_model. The grok-cli conditional now reports an 'enum' error at that same path (it was 'const' before), so grok-cli with a non-grok model was misclassified as lost enum membership. The filter now also requires schema_path to begin with 'properties', i.e. a property-level enum only. The assertion's intent (enum membership) is unchanged and no case was removed.
